# Fixtures

Raw SWPC content used by the tests. Tests read these files and never use the
network.

Each recorded file lives in `tests/fixtures/<product>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.<ext>`.
Every file is listed below with its source URL, the date it was recorded or
built, and its size. Files built by hand (for example the old array-of-arrays
formats) are marked as **built**, with the description they follow.

| File | Source | Date | Size | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
